e-commerce sectors, managing full SDLC from requirement scoping to post-launch support 
using Agile, Scrum and Waterfall methodologies.
	●​ Led cross-functional teams of 30+ members, including engineers, QA, UI/UX designers and 
business analysts across concurrent sprints, ensuring on-time delivery within defined scope 
and budget.
	●​ Directed end-to-end product lifecycle for logistics delivery applications (ride management, 
billing automation, shipping integration), reducing manual billing effort by 40% through 
seamless CRM and app integration.
	●​ Owned product roadmap, backlog management and sprint planning using Jira and 
Confluence, achieving consistent sprint velocity and reducing backlog debt by 30% over 6

an 80%+ proposal approval rate, directly contributing to business growth.

satisfaction rate.
	●​ Mentored and onboarded 8+ junior team members on Agile practices, documentation 
standards and delivery workflows, improving team productivity and reducing ramp-up time by 
25%.

Talent Acquisition Manager | Jan 2022 – Mar 2022
	●​ Built end-to-end talent pipelines across software development, sales and marketing functions, 
reducing average time-to-hire by 20% through structured screening and candidate matching 
processes.

job requirements, evaluate candidates and ensure alignment with business goals and team 
culture.


Software Engineer | Jul 2021 – Dec 2021

AngularJS, Python and HTML/CSS, collaborating with cross-functional teams across the full 
development lifecycle.
